item.title: India, US Deepen Supply Chain Ties Though Tariff Rift Persists
item.description: Though the future of its trade agreement with the United States is in flux, India has teamed with an American-led effort to safeguard supply chains.

item.title: AEO Lays Off 200+ in Quiet Logistics Winddown
item.description: The apparel retailer is cutting 211 jobs as it exits its third-party fulfillment services and shutters L.A.- and Boston-area warehouses.

item.title: Cotton Coalition Pushes BACA in House
item.description: NCC-led group urges lawmakers to back bill prioritizing U.S.-grown cotton in federal procurement and offering tax credits for domestic sourcing.

item.title: Scotch & Soda Brings Jean-Michel Basquiat’s Art to Denim
item.description: The collection reimagines Scotch & Soda's textures and signature silhouettes as a new background for Basquiat’s archival artwork.

item.title: Material World: DGBI Expands NIL Apparel with Colorado Launch
item.description: DBGI launches CU as the third university in its NIL Strategic Initiative, tapping into the $36.4 billion global sports merchandise market.

item.title: AI is at the Center of WiseTech Global’s 29% Staff Reduction
item.description: The E2open and CargoWise parent is laying off 2,000 employees, with CEO Zubin Appoo citing "clear evidence of greater output in shorter time frames with smaller AI-enabled teams.”

item.title: American Eagle Taps Stagecoach Performers for New Campaign
item.description: The retailer also launched the AE x Stagecoach co-branded collection.

item.title: Canada Should Brace for Tariffs No Matter What, US and Canadian Officials Say
item.description: For the United States’ neighbor to the North, tariffs are fast becoming a fact of life.

item.title: JD Sports Expands RFID Across Europe
item.description: JD Sports is deepening its investment in RFID with Checkpoint Systems as the British sportswear giant looks to tighten inventory control across Europe.

item.title: Amid Tariff Chaos, One Principle to Abide By: Don’t Harm Supply Chain Workers
item.description: Better Buying's data shows that when commercial pressures reach a breaking point, the risk of unauthorized subcontracting, excessive overtime and other workers’ rights violations can also increase.
